quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
حمٓ
وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

parent_channels.name: P1 (44:1-16) - Ordered Revelation as a Document Workflow

subchannels.name: A bound record made legible
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate pieces are joined and inscribed as a binding record whose contents are exposed through verbal or graphic signs.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining or stitching parts (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); written record (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); binding decree (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); emergence into clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); disclosure by speech, writing, or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:2 `كِتَابِ` (ك ت ب), `مُبِينِ` (ب ي ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Writing is not only inscription but the joining and fastening of parts. The manifest book therefore appears as a constructed record whose binding force and visible articulation make an authoritative whole available to be read.

subchannels.name: Matters sorted and ratified
subchannels.scene_or_process: A complete field of affairs is separated into distinguishable cases, deliberated, judged, and made precise.
subchannels.active_motifs: discrimination between things (`quranic:root_001148:B001/m01`); distribution into parts (`quranic:root_001148:B002/m01`); affairs or cases (`quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); deliberation and settled resolve (`quranic:root_000051:B007/m01`); adjudication (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); sound judgment (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); precise construction (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`); encompassing whole (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The wise affair is a decision mechanism rather than an undifferentiated topic. It divides a total field into cases, applies deliberative and judicial intelligence, and leaves each portion in a precise, binding form.

subchannels.name: Placed and dispatched from the source
subchannels.scene_or_process: The ratified content is put in its proper rank, sent downward, and released through a message-bearing envoy from a proximate source.
subchannels.active_motifs: sending something down (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); placing a thing in its proper station (`quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`); release and dispatch (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); envoy and carried message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); nearness and presence at the source (`quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:3 `أَنزَلْ` (ن ز ل); 44:5 `عِندِ` (ع ن د), `مُرْسِلِينَ` (ر س ل).
subchannels.synthesis: The decree moves as a controlled transmission: it is assigned a station, sent from a present source, and released through the same lexical machinery that carries both an envoy and the envoy's message.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authoritative content is assembled into a record, discriminated into determinate units, and dispatched from its source.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sequence joins writing's binding operation to decision's separating operation: what is first stitched into an intelligible whole is then sorted, ratified, placed, and released like an administrative dispatch.

parent_channels.name: P1 (44:1-16) - Generative Custody of Life

subchannels.name: Nurture within generative shelter
subchannels.scene_or_process: An owner-caretaker repairs and develops life within a merciful, womb-like shelter continuous with parental causation.
subchannels.active_motifs: ownership and lordship (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); gradual repair and nurture (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); merciful tenderness (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); womb as generative enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); fatherhood, upbringing, and generative causation (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The cluster gives custody a bodily and domestic mechanism. Rule becomes sustained repair and upbringing, while mercy supplies the enclosing womb in which life can be brought forth and maintained.

subchannels.name: Animation between rainfall and cessation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life rises through rain, vegetation, and animate force, is preserved from killing, and ends when that force is withdrawn.
subchannels.active_motifs: earth enlivened by rain and vegetation (`quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`); animate life (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); preservation from killing (`quranic:root_000383:B006/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); removal or weakening of force (`quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`); first beginning (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:8 `يُحْىِ` (ح ي ي), `يُمِيتُ` (م و ت), `أَوَّلِينَ` (ء و ل).
subchannels.synthesis: Giving life expands into the revival of land and the preservation of living beings; causing death is its exact reversal, the withdrawal of force. The reference to firstness fixes both operations within an originating life cycle.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Legitimate lordship originates, shelters, develops, preserves, and can withdraw animate force.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mercy's womb, the parent's formative care, rain-fed animation, and the removal of force materialize lordship as an intimate ecology of generation rather than title alone.

parent_channels.name: P1 (44:1-16) - An Observed Cycle of Affliction

subchannels.name: A lookout sees the shroud approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: Advance warning places a watcher at a lookout as a dark, oppressive event moves in across the overhead field.
subchannels.active_motifs: alarm that activates caution (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`); watchful waiting (`quranic:root_000584:B001/m01`); guarding and surveillance (`quranic:root_000584:B002/m01`); elevated lookout (`quranic:root_000584:B003/m01`); arrival (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); arriving calamity or hostile overhang (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`); severe event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`); smoke rising from combustion (`quranic:root_000465:B001/m01`); black turbidity (`quranic:root_000465:B003/m01`); oppressive smoky day (`quranic:root_000465:B007/m01`); overhead sky or cloud (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:3 `مُنذِرِينَ` (ن ذ ر); 44:10 `ٱرْتَقِبْ` (ر ق ب), `يَوْمَ` (ي و م), `تَأْتِى` (ء ت ي), `سَّمَاءُ` (س م و), `دُخَانٍ` (د خ ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Warning creates a sentinel scene before the affliction becomes bodily. From a lexical watchtower, the observer sees an event advancing under the sky as rising smoke, black murk, and an atmosphere of heat and constriction.

subchannels.name: A blanket that occludes and hurts
subchannels.scene_or_process: A generalized covering settles over people and converts atmospheric occlusion into inflicted pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: covering that hides what lies beneath (`quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`); calamity that envelops a population (`quranic:root_001088:B002/m01`); punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); felt pain (`quranic:root_000046:B001/m01`); infliction of pain (`quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:11 `يَغْشَى` (غ ش و), `عَذَابٌ` (ع ذ ب), `أَلِيمٌ` (ء ل م).
subchannels.synthesis: The smoke does not merely obscure vision. Its covering function becomes a population-wide seizure of the body, joining the enveloping event to both the experience and deliberate infliction of pain.

subchannels.name: Cover lifted, condition resumed
subchannels.scene_or_process: The covering and distress are removed for a slight interval, but the subjects resume a recurrent condition like a returning fever or ingrained habit.
subchannels.active_motifs: lifting a cover or distress (`quranic:root_001302:B001/m01`); exposing what had been hidden (`quranic:root_001302:B002/m01`); punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); return and fever-like recurrence (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); habituated repetition (`quranic:root_001058:B004/m01`); slight amount or interval (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:12 `ٱكْشِفْ` (ك ش ف), `عَذَابَ` (ع ذ ب); 44:15 `كَاشِفُوا` (ك ش ف), `عَذَابِ` (ع ذ ب), `قَلِيلًا` (ق ل ل), `عَائِدُونَ` (ع و د).
subchannels.synthesis: Relief behaves as temporary exposure rather than cure. Once the cover is raised, the underlying disposition returns with the regularity of recurrent illness and the force of an acquired habit.

subchannels.name: The cycle closes as a punitive grasp
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recurrence culminates in a violent taking whose magnitude and retaliatory purpose remove the earlier interval of relief.
subchannels.active_motifs: violent seizure (`quranic:root_000126:B001/m01`); great magnitude (`quranic:root_001281:B001/m01`); burdensome severity (`quranic:root_001281:B010/m01`); rejection and grievance (`quranic:root_001545:B001/m01`); retaliatory punishment (`quranic:root_001545:B002/m01`); severe event (`quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:16 `يَوْمَ` (ي و م), `نَبْطِشُ/بَطْشَةَ` (ب ط ش), `كُبْرَى` (ك ب ر), `مُنتَقِمُونَ` (ن ق م).
subchannels.synthesis: What first arrived as a diffuse shroud contracts into the focused action of a hand. Magnitude is now the weight of the seizure, and grievance becomes its retaliatory outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A warned-of pressure approaches, covers its subjects, briefly recedes, and returns in a more decisive form.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same event is rendered as a sentinel's sighting, an atmospheric shroud, a clinical remission and relapse, and finally the grip of a hand.

parent_channels.name: P1 (44:1-16) - Reception and Counter-Framing

subchannels.name: A signal heard into marked certainty
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound is received, understood, and obeyed; knowledge recognizes distinguishing marks until uncertainty is displaced.
subchannels.active_motifs: auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); understanding and compliance (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); knowledge and recognition (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); distinguishing mark or way-sign (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); settled certainty (`quranic:root_001696:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Hearing is completed not by acoustic contact but by comprehension and responsive action. Knowledge then reads marks as evidence, producing a certainty that is both perceptual and orienting.

subchannels.name: A reminder arrives as explicit message
subchannels.scene_or_process: A messenger's arrival restores absent knowledge by making it present in memory and explicit in language.
subchannels.active_motifs: recall after absence (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); reminder that causes recollection (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); arrival and presence (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`); envoy and carried message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); emergence into clarity (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); disclosure by language or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:13 `ذِّكْرَى` (ذ ك ر), `جَاءَ` (ج ي ء), `رَسُولٌ` (ر س ل), `مُّبِينٌ` (ب ي ن).
subchannels.synthesis: The messenger does not supply a novel object alone; arrival reactivates memory. Explicit discourse makes what should be recalled visible again and gives recollection a public carrier.

subchannels.name: Withdrawal manufactures a counter-story
subchannels.scene_or_process: The receiver turns away, replaces the message with a false attribution, and circulates a diagnosis that figures reason as covered.
subchannels.active_motifs: withdrawal and refusal of proximity (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`); spoken assertion (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); false attribution of unsaid material (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); circulating public talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); learned or taught knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m02`); reason covered by madness (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`); hidden interior mind (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:14 `تَوَلَّ` (و ل ي), `قَالُ` (ق و ل), `مُعَلَّمٌ` (ع ل م), `مَجْنُونٌ` (ج ن ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Refusal is an active discourse operation. Turning away breaks reception, while speech fabricates and broadcasts a replacement account: teaching is recoded as external scripting and the messenger's inner reason as concealed by madness.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A message becomes effective through perception, recognition, and recollection, but a resistant receiver can recode disclosure as rumor or derangement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The communicative chain moves from ear to understanding to identifying mark and memory, then reverses when withdrawal converts a clear message into a circulating false attribution.

parent_channels.name: P2 (44:17-33) - Assay and Legitimate Custody

subchannels.name: The emissary as assayed material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire-like testing separates sound material from dross and discloses an envoy as noble and trustworthy.

parent_channels.name: P2 (44:17-33) - A Water Corridor That Reverses Roles

parent_channels.name: P2 (44:17-33) - A Cultivated Estate Changes Hands

parent_channels.name: P3 (44:34-47) - A Claim Must Become Embodied

parent_channels.name: P3 (44:34-47) - Purposive Making Versus Play

subchannels.synthesis: The rejected alternative is not another kind of successful creation. It is counterfeit speech or motion without a governing end, whose material analogue is wind that toys with a habitation until the made world's legible traces are gone.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Deliberate creation produces measured, fitted form, while counterfeit or playful making lacks a stable end and erases rather than establishes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation becomes the work of measuring, cutting, weaving, and fitting joints; play becomes both purposeless manipulation and wind that scours a dwelling away.

parent_channels.name: P3 (44:34-47) - An Appointed Assembly Strips Patronage

subchannels.name: Fruit admitted, death excluded
subchannels.scene_or_process: Secure inhabitants summon any desired fruit, but a protective boundary prevents death and furnace punishment from entering their field of experience.
subchannels.active_motifs: summons or request (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); complete availability (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); edible fruit (`quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`); delighted enjoyment (`quranic:root_001174:B001/m01`); security without fear (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); tasting food (`quranic:root_000526:B001/m01`); undergoing an experience (`quranic:root_000526:B002/m02`); loss of life (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); single death-event (`quranic:root_001454:B008/m01`); first occurrence (`quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`); protective barrier (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); punitive pain (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); blazing furnace (`quranic:root_000225:B001/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:55 `يَدْعُ` (د ع و), `كُلِّ` (ك ل ل), `فَاكِهَةٍ` (ف ك ه), `ءَامِنِينَ` (ء م ن); 44:56 `يَذُوقُ` (ذ و ق), `مَوْتَ/مَوْتَةَ` (م و ت), `أُولَى` (ء و ل), `وَقَى` (و ق ي), `عَذَابَ` (ع ذ ب), `جَحِيمِ` (ج ح م).
subchannels.synthesis: The contrast is an economy of sensory access. Fruit enters on demand; fear does not. Death is acknowledged as one completed event but is thereafter kept outside the protected field, just as furnace punishment is stopped at its boundary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is forced into the body, freely available to it, or barred from it reveals the subject's actual status.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Claimed height, chiefship, might, and honor are overturned by a descending punitive liquid, while secure subjects command fruit and experience a barrier that excludes death itself from taste.

parent_channels.name: P4 (44:48-59) - A Protected, Reciprocal Enclosure

subchannels.name: A shielded station with concealed water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Self-protection culminates in a secure residence whose tree-cover conceals and shields flowing springs.
subchannels.active_motifs: barrier against harm (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); active self-protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); settled residence (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); sustaining livelihood (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); concealment (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); tree-screened garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); defensive shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); flowing spring (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 44:51 `مُتَّقِينَ` (و ق ي), `مَقَامٍ` (ق و م), `أَمِينٍ` (ء م ن); 44:52 `جَنَّاتٍ` (ج ن ن), `عُيُونٍ` (ع ي ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Safety is built as a habitat. A station fixes the residents in place, vegetation screens the interior, the same root supplies a shield, and springs sustain the protected enclosure from within.

subchannels.name: Clothing extends the enclosure onto the body
subchannels.scene_or_process: The habitat's covering and shield functions are miniaturized as garments and armor worn by its inhabitants.
subchannels.active_motifs: garment as bodily cover (`quranic:root_001341:B001/m01`); armor worn for defense (`quranic:root_001341:B002/m01`); defensive shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); protective barrier (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Covering operates at two scales. The garden hides and shields the community; clothing repeats that enclosure around each body, with the lexical extension from dress to armor making security wearable.

subchannels.name: Facing pairs form reciprocal alignment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Face-to-face placement, accepted pairing, matched components, reciprocal gaze, and dialogue organize a nonhierarchical social circle.
subchannels.active_motifs: direct facing (`quranic:root_001198:B001/m01`); receptive acceptance (`quranic:root_001198:B004/m01`); matched parts joined opposite one another (`quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`); paired units (`quranic:root_000652:B001/m01`); spouses (`quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`); making one a companion to another (`quranic:root_000652:B003/m01`); high-contrast beauty of the eye (`quranic:root_000369:B001/m01`); reciprocal dialogue (`quranic:root_000369:B006/m01`); turning around an axis (`quranic:root_000369:B007/m01`); seeing eye (`quranic:root_001069:B001/m01`); broad beautiful eye (`quranic:root_001069:B016/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The social form is constructed from mutual orientation. Individuals become matched parts, companions face one another, gaze is reciprocal, and conversation can circulate around the resulting axis rather than descend through rank.

subchannels.name: Surplus becomes safe passage and settled success
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protective care carries subjects through a deathly wilderness into rescue, surplus, and honored settlement.
subchannels.active_motifs: surplus beyond need (`quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`); freely bestowed gift (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); lordly ownership (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); sustained care and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); rescue and attainment (`quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`); wilderness poised between escape and destruction (`quranic:root_001186:B003/m01`); greatness and power (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); honor and sanctity (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`); protective barrier (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Success is not mere acquisition. Its root also names the perilous waterless waste, so victory becomes safe passage through exposure; lordly care provides the barrier, and surplus marks arrival in an honored, sustaining settlement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Safety is constructed through station, enclosure, water, clothing, aligned relations, and a granted passage out of danger.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The garden's concealment, shield, armor, matching components, dialogue-axis, and wilderness rescue form a defended social habitat rather than a decorative inventory.

parent_channels.name: P4 (44:48-59) - Articulation Makes a Tractable Medium

subchannels.name: Ease travels through tongue into memory
subchannels.scene_or_process: A difficult message is made ready for light movement through an eloquent language, restoring content to active recollection.
subchannels.active_motifs: opening and ease after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); light, compliant movement (`quranic:root_001694:B005/m01`); speech organ (`quranic:root_001355:B001/m01`); eloquent articulation (`quranic:root_001355:B003/m01`); language and carried message (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`); recall after absence (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); spoken mention (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); reminder that activates recollection (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Ease is a transmission property: it prepares the content and makes its movement compliant. The tongue then articulates it in a language capable of carrying the message until remembrance becomes active rather than merely stored.

subchannels.name: Fibers prepared and twisted into cloth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Raw fiber is worked into strands, twisted in a set direction, and realized as fabric and garment.
subchannels.active_motifs: goat-hair fabric (`quranic:root_000748:B001/m01`); garment as bodily cover (`quranic:root_001341:B001/m02`); fiber cleaned and prepared for twisting (`quranic:root_001355:B009/m01`); downward twisting of a strand (`quranic:root_001694:B009/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: unavailable for `quranic:root_000748:B001/m01` (س ن د س); 44:53 `يَلْبَسُ` (ل ب س); 44:58 `لِسَانِ` (ل س ن), `يَسَّرْ` (ي س ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The textile scene gives physical form to articulation. Fibers are separated and readied, then coordinated by twist into a stable strand and finally a covering; the operation mirrors how discrete sounds become a coherent linguistic medium.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Discrete elements become usable when they are eased, aligned, articulated, or twisted into a medium that carries meaning or covers a body.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 44:53 `يَلْبَسُ` and 44:58 `يَسَّرْ/لِسَانِ/يَتَذَكَّرُ`; the س ن د س branch has no available surface anchor.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech production and cloth production become functional analogues: ease lets language move through the tongue into memory, while prepared fibers are twisted into wearable material.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 (44:1-16) - A Night Encampment of Fixed Provision
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A traveler descends at night, the camel kneels and remains, and an encampment supplies a water basin, milk, and stable abundance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: night and darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); descent, dismounting, and lodging (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); prepared provision for a guest (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); camel kneeling and remaining (`quranic:root_000109:B001/m01`); fixed water basin (`quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`); stable, growing good (`quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`); milk drawn from a kneeling camel (`quranic:root_000109:B007/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 44:3 `لَيْلَةٍ` (ل ي ل), `أَنزَلْ` (ن ز ل), `مُّبَارَكَةٍ` (ب ر ك).
parent_channels.synthesis: The blessed night materializes as a complete hospitality scene. Descent becomes lodging; blessing supplies the fixed kneeling posture, retained water, milk, and durable increase that make the nocturnal stopping place provisioned and fertile.

parent_channels.name: S2. P4 (44:48-59) - Mutual Watch at the Close
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Speaker and opponents occupy reciprocal positions of watchful waiting, each oriented toward the other's expected outcome.
parent_channels.active_motifs: observation and waiting (`quranic:root_000584:B001/m01`); guarding and surveillance (`quranic:root_000584:B002/m01`); elevated lookout (`quranic:root_000584:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The doubled root creates a symmetrical surveillance frame: command and reported state mirror one another. Both sides wait, but the shared posture does not imply a shared object, horizon, or expected result.

parent_channels.name: S3. A Hunter Tests and Draws from Cover
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hunter goes out for game, takes cover behind a blind, inspects the bow's string clearance, tests its resistance, and draws it to its limit for a subsistence shot.
parent_channels.active_motifs: departure to seek game (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); hunter's blind (`quranic:root_000584:B011/m01`); bow whose string lies dangerously close (`quranic:root_000156:B005/m01`); string separated from the bow's belly (`quranic:root_000170:B008/m01`); testing a bow by pulling its string (`quranic:root_000526:B003/m01`); full draw that sends an arrow far (`quranic:root_001080:B004/m01`); hunting bow that feeds its owner (`quranic:root_000934:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The hunt turns the surah's repeated watching into trained delay rather than passive waiting. Concealment, inspection, and stored draw precede the decisive outcome, so the opponents' reciprocal watch at 44:59 is usefully pressured by an unequal hunter-quarry frame: one side waits while the punitive sequence is already tensioned toward seizure.

parent_channels.name: S4. A Camel Is Divided by Lots
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Gambling arrows are kept together, supervised, and drawn to assign portions of a slaughtered camel, while a nonparticipant withdraws from the gambling party.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather holder containing lot-arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); gambling overseer (`quranic:root_000584:B006/m01`); third lot-arrow (`quranic:root_000584:B006/m02`); the `mu'alla` lot-arrow (`quranic:root_001042:B009/m01`); players using arrows to slaughter and apportion a camel (`quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`); person who stands apart from the gamblers (`quranic:root_001009:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The game gives concrete form to partition by turning one animal body into shares assigned through concealed lots and a human overseer. It usefully pressures the surah's opposition between play and purpose: the wise differentiation of affairs at 44:4 and the final separation at 44:40 are not chance allotments, but determinate judgments whose authority does not depend on a draw.

parent_channels.name: S5. A Burial Assembly Is Reopened
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A body is borne to burial, wrapped and hidden in a grave marked by stones and a canopy; a camel is tethered there until it dies, before reanimation reverses the enclosure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: funeral bier or carrier (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); shrouding and interment (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`); grave and cairn stones (`quranic:root_000547:B005/m01`); grave canopy (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m01`); grave-camel tethered without food or water until death (`quranic:root_000153:B005/m01`); raising the dead back to life (`quranic:root_001503:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The cluster materializes what the deniers in 44:34-36 treat as death's finality: transport stops, cloth and earth hide the body, stones fix the place, and another life is made to expire beside it. The `ن ش ر` activation then reopens that complete burial assembly, reframing resurrection as reversal of a concrete social and material closure rather than an abstract repetition of life.

parent_channels.name: S6. A Wedding Is Installed and Sung
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A marriage is ratified with a dowry, a bridal pavilion is raised for entry to the spouse, and singers accompany the new household through reciprocal performance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: marriage dowry (`quranic:root_000852:B007/m01`); bridal pavilion and entry to one's spouse (`quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`); marriage as protection and sufficiency (`quranic:root_001110:B006/m01`); bride or married woman sufficient in spouse or beauty (`quranic:root_001110:B005/m01`); spouses joined as a pair (`quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`); pleasurable performed singing (`quranic:root_000741:B007/m01`); reciprocal accompaniment in song (`quranic:root_000563:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The wedding scene materializes the pairing at 44:54 as social installation rather than bare juxtaposition. Dowry, pavilion, entry, and responsive song place the spouses inside a publicly marked and protected household, strengthening the primary movement from exposed judgment to secure incorporation and celebration.

parent_channels.name: S7. A Waterskin Holds, Balances, and Releases Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Tanned hide is fitted with a load-balancing handle, a lower spout, and a thin eye that can seal or leak; wear tests whether the vessel retains water before pouring.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tanned hide used as vessel material (`quranic:root_000369:B004/m01`); load-balancing handle on a waterskin (`quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`); lower waterskin spout (`quranic:root_001009:B006/m01`); thin eye or hole that leaks or seals (`quranic:root_001069:B007/m01`); wear through use or travel (`quranic:root_000153:B001/m01`); controlled pouring (`quranic:root_000838:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The vessel miniaturizes the surah's water contrasts into a hand-scale control system. Held provision depends on fitted openings and sound material, while wear or an unsealed eye converts retention into loss; this mechanism materializes the difference between the sea as a divinely managed passage and engulfing trap, hot water as punitive outflow, and springs as secured abundance.

parent_channels.name: S8. A Written Manumission Changes Legal Status
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person held as saleable property is represented legally by the neck, enters a written installment contract for release, and emerges into covenantal clientage rather than remaining chattel.
parent_channels.active_motifs: saleable enslaved person (`quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`); neck standing for an enslaved person, captive, or object of emancipation (`quranic:root_000584:B004/m01`); written manumission contract payable in installments (`quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`); covenant and protected pact (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); legal patronage after manumission (`quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The practice sharpens Moses' demand that Pharaoh hand over God's servants at 44:18. Human ownership releases chattel through price, writing, and a changed patronal relation; calling the people `عِبَادَ اللَّهِ` instead displaces Pharaoh's title at the outset. The exodus is thereby reframed as a transfer of legal and covenantal status, not merely a change of location.

parent_channels.name: S9. A House Is Censed through a Smoke Vent
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aloeswood is heated on a perfume brazier, fire is managed to generate smoke, and a censer or wall opening conducts the scented plume through an interior.
parent_channels.active_motifs: aloeswood incense (`quranic:root_000076:B014/m01`); fire raised deliberately to generate smoke (`quranic:root_000465:B002/m01`); censing a house with incense (`quranic:root_000465:B002/m02`); smoke outlet or incense burner (`quranic:root_000465:B006/m01`); perfume brazier (`quranic:root_000973:B012/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: unavailable for `quranic:root_000076:B014/m01` (ء ل ي); 44:10 `بِدُخَانٍ` (د خ ن); 44:18 `عِبَادَ` (ع ب د).
parent_channels.synthesis: Domestic censing gives the smoke of 44:10 a controlled counter-scene. A householder selects the fuel, raises the plume, and channels it through an interior; the promised smoke reverses every control, becoming an unwanted public atmosphere that covers the people. The concrete practice therefore materializes the warning as saturation of inhabited space, not a distant sign in the sky.

parent_channels.name: S10. P2-P3 Contrast-and-Reversal Bridge - A Guarantor Cannot Stand In
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Across P2 (44:17-33) and P3 (44:34-47), a sponsor undertakes responsibility for another in writing, and a proximate proxy stands in for the principal; the appointed judgment then cancels that substitutive capacity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: written undertaking of guarantee (`quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`); surety assuming responsibility for a person (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); proxy standing in another's place (`quranic:root_001273:B007/m01`); proximity without an intervening gap (`quranic:root_001684:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 44:17 `قَبْلَهُمْ` (ق ب ل), `قَوْمَ` (ق و م); 44:27 `كَانُوا` (ك و ن); 44:37 `قَوْمُ` (ق و م), `قَبْلِهِمْ` (ق ب ل), `كَانُوا` (ك و ن); 44:41 `مَوْلًى/مَوْلًى` (و ل ي).
parent_channels.synthesis: The P2 custody demand permits authorized representation: a trusted envoy speaks under warrant and calls for a transfer of persons. At P3's appointed separation, ordinary surety logic is reversed; proximity, undertaking, and proxy status cannot make one `mawla` answer for another. Delegated agency can carry a command, but judgmental liability cannot be transferred.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1-P2 Contrast-and-Causal Bridge - A Relief Plea and an Invocation Against Crime
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (44:1-16) supplies a supplicant who addresses the sovereign Lord, asks that distress be uncovered, and seeks acceptance; P2 (44:17-33) reverses the direction of the plea when Moses invokes a harmful descent against the criminal community, after which departure and punishment proceed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sovereign Lord addressed by the petitioner (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); distress uncovered and removed (`quranic:root_001302:B001/m01`); Amen as a request for response (`quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`); prayerful vocal invocation (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m02`); invocation of a harmful event against another (`quranic:root_000478:B004/m01`); answering a caller with a responsive formula (`quranic:root_001573:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 44:12 `رَبَّنَا` (ر ب ب), `ٱكْشِفْ` (ك ش ف), `مُؤْمِنُونَ` (ء م ن); 44:15 `كَاشِفُوا` (ك ش ف); 44:22 `دَعَا/رَبَّهُ` (د ع و/ر ب ب); unavailable for `quranic:root_001573:B003/m01` (ه ا ء).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is a contrast between two speech acts and their causal durability. The latent Amen sense under `مُؤْمِنُونَ` makes the P1 profession sound like a response-seeking seal on the request for relief, but the resumed conduct at 44:15 exposes formula without lasting assent. Moses' P2 call instead names criminality and opens directly into commanded escape and judgment. The channel usefully pressures the primary reading by locating answered prayer not in the presence of an invocation formula alone, but in whether speech, allegiance, and the ensuing action remain aligned.

parent_channels.name: S12. P1-P3 Emergence-and-Restoration Bridge - A Newborn Is Received and the Mother Recovers
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1's life-giving custody (44:6-8) and P3's demand for restored bodies (44:34-36) share an emergence invariant: a hidden living body exits its enclosure, is received by another agent, and is followed by maternal pain, care, treatment, and recovery.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fetus hidden in the maternal body (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); womb as the child's generative enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); midwife receiving the emerging newborn (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`); afterbirth issuing from the womb after the child (`quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`); mother remaining close to the newborn (`quranic:root_001059:B003/m01`); postpartum womb pain or retained afterbirth (`quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`); date-and-fenugreek remedy prepared for the postpartum mother (`quranic:root_001148:B012/m01`); recovery from postpartum illness (`quranic:root_001042:B011/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs form one role-complete birth sequence: concealment gives way to delivery, the midwife receives what emerges, the afterbirth marks completion, and maternal attachment, pain, medicine, and convalescence stabilize the new life. This materializes P1's divine giving of life as a vulnerable passage into embodied presence. It also usefully pressures P3's confinement of existence to a first death: restoration is reframed through the concrete analogue of a body brought out of hidden enclosure and received into life, not as a bodiless repetition.

parent_channels.name: S13. P2-P3 Transport-Reversal Bridge - A Mount Is Padded, Covered, and Girt
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P2's commanded night departure at 44:23 is materialized by a layered camel-saddle assembly, while P3's forced haulage at 44:47 reverses the transport roles by contrasting protected riders with a condemned person made into seized load.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bare wooden saddle frame (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); leather covering fitted over the saddle (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m01`); felt or cloth underlay beneath the saddle (`quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`); riding pad placed on the camel's back (`quranic:root_000766:B010/m01`); belly strap tightened to secure the assembly (`quranic:root_000128:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Frame, leather cover, underlay, back pad, and belly strap form one load-bearing instrument whose layers distribute pressure and keep rider, equipment, and mount aligned. That concrete assembly supports P2's night exodus as prepared and protected conveyance. Across the boundary, P3 reverses the invariant: the condemned body has no riding position, cushioning, or agency, but is grasped and dragged toward the furnace center. The contrast sharpens the primary distinction between being carried under legitimate custody and being transported as the object of judgment.
